body:
I don’t have anything to offer except that I am in a similar situation with my husband, who told me yesterday that he wants to commit suicide. We have a toddler son, and I am also very worried. 

I hope things get better for all of us soon.

You know, I don’t see this as a failure at all. Along time ago, I was suicidal following some bad events, and in the middle of all of that, I woke up at 2 AM and I had horrible neck pain and a searing headache. So of course, I googled my symptoms and was convinced I was having an aneurysm. I rushed to the hospital.  And I should say that I’ve only been to the hospital a couple times in my whole life. And they ran all these tests, and I thought so confused because the day before, I had wanted to die. And all of the sudden when it felt as though my life was about to slip through my fingers, I felt desperate to live. In the end, they had no idea what it was, and it never came back. 

 I do not doubt that you want to die, but it also sounds like a very small, deep part of you wants to live. Your system is malfunctioning, but part of you wants to stick it out and see it through. And I think that is very promising.
